purpose: Wave-5 thin-skill training gap fill for Construction, Runecrafting, Hunter, Farming, Cooking, Smithing residuals, Agility high residual methods, and Firemaking residuals — wiki-published XP rates only; ironman/Equilibrium region notes; no invented rates.

methods.method: Construction Contracts by plank tier (wiki XP/h table)
methods.location: Estate-agent contracts (house hotspots); restock often at Ithell/Prif or nearest estate agent
methods.xp_rate: wiki Construction training contract XP Rates table: normal planks 100,000 XP/h (lodestones) / 108,000 (instant teleports) / 177,000 (Master constructor's outfit); oak 183,000 / 207,000 / 262,000; teak 270,000 / 318,000 / 375,000; mahogany 347,000 / 461,000 / 550,000
methods.intensity: semi-AFK hotspot builds with teleport restock
methods.notes: Ironman: plank box upgrades + BoB before max box; teak is cost-efficient (~−0.73 gp/XP on GE teak/mithril nails cited on page); mahogany is the high XP band. Page banner: may be outdated after 2026 Construction update — re-check before optimizer rank. Complements Fort Forinthry builds (Misthalin working taxonomy).
methods.warning: Construction training page carries a 2026 Construction update out-of-date banner.

methods.method: Dream of Iaia stonemason station (stored Construction XP withdraw)
methods.level_range: after building the Iaia stonemason station; restock from Anachronia base camp stones
methods.location: Dream of Iaia (Anachronia)
methods.xp_rate: wiki: station stores up to 350,000 Construction XP; withdrawing stored XP is 350,000 experience per hour while skilling at the station (plus 15,000 direct XP when restocked from base-camp stones per stated build reward path)
methods.intensity: AFK withdraw after active stone restock
methods.notes: Passive/AFK Construction sink once the station is built. Ironman: Anachronia base camp stone supply is the gate. Not a continuous infinite grind without restocking stones.

methods.location: Runespan via Wizards' Tower portal (Misthalin)
methods.xp_rate: wiki Pay-to-play Runecrafting training: ~63,000 XP/h at 66 on islands 12-16; ~93,000 XP/h from 90 using platforms 32/30/29/27/25; optimised setups with ethereal/master robes + urns/enhancer cited at 100,000-150,000 XP/h (double with bonus XP)
methods.intensity: active node routing; low click when camping good islands
methods.notes: Ironman default early/mid RC without pure essence bank. Page incomplete for necrotic runes, 110 RC, and Savvy Runecrafting unlocks — treat high-end as pre-Savvy baseline. Runesphere dust exchange still up to ~25,000 XP/day on ironman notes (separate D&D).
methods.warning: Training page incomplete after 110 Runecrafting / Savvy unlocks; re-benchmark high rates.

methods.method: Soul altar charged crafts (AFK essence sink)
methods.location: Soul altar (fairy ring CKQ for fastest access on wiki)
methods.xp_rate: wiki: charging then crafting soul runes grants 77,000 experience before boosts per full charged craft cycle (not a frozen continuous XP/h); AFK method described as large XP chunks rather than Runespan-style continuous siphoning
methods.notes: Ironman pure-essence sink once banked from PvM/Slayer. Desert geography for altar; Abyss alternate path is Forinthry-gated. Do not invent XP/h from the 77k figure without trip timing.

methods.method: Imbuing eternal magic weapons (and level-109 sacrifice)
methods.location: Eternal magic weapon imbuing interface (Prifddinas / eternal magic path)
methods.xp_rate: wiki: at 106 Runecrafting up to 287,600 XP/h imbuing staves and 245,600 XP/h with wands and orbs (not counting banking). Stockpiling finished items and sacrificing at 109: up to 606,800 XP/h with staves and 519,600 XP/h with wands/orbs (not counting banking)
methods.notes: Analogous to burial smithing / martial fletching — consume products for XP. Ironman: eternal magic supply is Tirannwn-hard; treat as late-game ceiling not early League default.

methods.location: Het's Oasis whirligig ponds
methods.xp_rate: wiki Hunter training: over 70,000 XP/h
methods.notes: Desert continuous Hunter spine start. Summary table flagged out of date after 2026 early-game rebalance — body text still publishes 70k+ for gliding. Pair with flower/bush Farming at the Oasis.
methods.warning: Hunter summary rates marked stale post-2026 early-game rebalance; re-benchmark before optimizer ranking.

methods.location: Het's Oasis
methods.xp_rate: wiki: over 125,000 XP/h before 1,500-catch 5% unlock; over 130,000 XP/h after; with Dundee crocodile upgrades expanding catch count, rates climb over 200,000 XP/h
methods.notes: Requires irises in flower boxes. Ironman: cultivate Oasis flowers while hunting. Stale-summary banner applies to optimizer use of the summary table.

methods.location: Het's Oasis
methods.xp_rate: wiki body: ~125,000 XP/h base, or up to ~200,000 XP/h with all Dundee's Crocodile Upgrades plus 10% Het statue bonus (16% passive XP total from upgrades+statue framing)
methods.notes: Requires hydrangeas. Prefer body-text rates over the summary table which still carries a rebalance stale banner. Shells and pieces of Het side loot.

methods.location: Het's Oasis (hollyhocks attract)
methods.xp_rate: wiki worked example: 580 XP per catch + 145 XP per stack, 5 stacks every ~7s → 1,305 XP / 7s; if maintained with max stacks ~670,000 XP/h base. Intense continuous click method
methods.notes: High-end Desert Hunter before/alongside Havenhythe BGH. Page also notes Havenhythe BGH summary band 420,000-2,464,500 XP/h as the top alternative at 96-110+.

methods.location: Wilderness black salamander net-trap area
methods.xp_rate: wiki: 110,000-186,000 experience per hour
methods.notes: Hard Forinthry/Wilderness. Alternative to whirligigs when Desert is locked. Ironman ammo/tool use for net traps.

methods.location: Wilderness charming moth area
methods.xp_rate: wiki: 180,000-240,000 Hunter XP/h; training-methods corpus also cites ~34,000-45,000 Agility XP/h with no items on the current guide framing
methods.notes: Multi-skill: Hunter + Agility + Summoning charms (~360 charms/h around 99 on prior guide notes). Ignore any remaining Demonic Skull boost text — skull removed mid-game rebalance July 2026.
methods.warning: Do not apply Demonic Skull XP assumptions.

methods.location: Havenhythe Big Game Hunter sites
methods.xp_rate: wiki Hunter training summary: 420,000-2,464,500 XP/h (upper bound example: ~20 kills/h at 96 ≈420,000; up to 2,464,500 at 110 killing giant dashing kebbit under stated assumptions). Page flagged may be outdated after Havenhythe / 110 Hunter
methods.notes: Jagex-framed top Hunter XP path post-Havenhythe. Ironman: region unlock + encounter gear. Prefer live re-benchmark for League optimizer ceilings.
methods.warning: Hunter page may be outdated after Havenhythe part 1 / 110 Hunter.

methods.level_range: 88+ fungal spores; 92+ enriched spores; extreme hunter boost for top band
methods.location: Croesus Front decaying Lumbridge/Varrock guards (outside boss arena)
methods.xp_rate: wiki: over 575,000 XP/h at 99 on enriched route; summary alternatives cite 450,000-500,000 with extreme hunter on enriched, and 500,000-575,000 for fungal/enriched spore gathering
methods.intensity: active node hopping; porters or keybind drop
methods.notes: Starting-region high Hunter XP without Desert/Havenhythe. Use porters or drop to keep inventory clear.

methods.location: Any dense seed-drop combat (vyres, multi Slayer, etc.) with seedicide equipped
methods.xp_rate: wiki Farming training active methods: level 7 ~20,000 XP/h; level 74 ~250,000 XP/h (section title rates)
methods.notes: Destroys seed drops for double plant XP. Synergizes with Morytania vyres and high-seed tasks. Not a substitute for herb/tree runs for Herblore supply.

methods.location: Prifddinas / Tirannwn rumberry bush forage spots on the training page
methods.xp_rate: wiki Farming training active methods: ~30,000 XP/h at level 86
methods.notes: Continuous Farming XP when patches are on timers. Hard Tirannwn/Prif dependency.

methods.location: Mushroom cluster forage (training page active methods)
methods.xp_rate: wiki Farming training active methods: ~50,000 XP/h at level 94
methods.notes: Higher continuous forage than rumberries. Still below seedicide high-combat rates; use between patch runs.

methods.location: Bank + portable range (w84 Fort/Lumbridge market) or permanent range/bonfire
methods.xp_rate: wiki Pay-to-play Cooking training recommended table: ~150,000 base XP/h; ~181,000 with portable range; ~178,600 with cooking urns
methods.notes: ~1,000 sweetcorn to 52 on the table. Ironman: farm sweetcorn allotments. Portable range is main-game convenience; ironmen use player bonfires (+10%) and Fort tier-3 kitchen (+5%) stacks where available.

methods.location: Bank + portable range or ironman player bonfire / Fort kitchen
methods.xp_rate: wiki recommended table: 210 XP/item; ~294,000 base XP/h; ~355,000 portable range; ~352,800 with cooking urns. Stop-burn ~94 with cooking gauntlets
methods.notes: Ironman deep-sea / frenzy shark supply. Cooking gauntlets (Family Crest, Asgarnia) reduce burns.

methods.level_range: high Cooking (wiki high-end food ladder after rocktails)
methods.location: Bank + portable range or ironman bonfire/Fort kitchen
methods.xp_rate: wiki recommended table: 270 XP/item; ~378,000 base XP/h; ~457,000 portable range; ~453,600 with cooking urns
methods.notes: Top continuous cook rates on the recommended fish ladder short of wine. Ironman: high-level Fishing supply gate.

methods.level_range: 35+ Wine making; used as high XP spam when grapes/jugs available
methods.location: Bank (ferment in bank)
methods.xp_rate: wiki alternative methods Wine section: upwards of 700,000 Cooking XP/h; 200 XP per jug of wine (up to 2,800 XP per 14-grape inventory if no bad wine)
methods.notes: Expensive on GE (wiki cites large gp loss per inventory). Ironman: grape supply is the hard gate — treat as burst method not default food production.

methods.method: Burial armour / burial sets at Artisans' Workshop
methods.level_range: burial unlock tiers through elder rune sets (90+ for elder rune burial set best rates)
methods.location: Artisans' Workshop burial forge and anvil (Falador)
methods.xp_rate: wiki: experience rates can far exceed 1,000,000 XP/h depending on item; intro also states ideal high-end burial setups over 4,000,000 XP/h off Double XP. Full burial set gives 5% extra XP vs parts. Elder rune burial set currently best rates on page
methods.notes: Asgarnia hub. Ironman: mine/smelt ladder + respect unlocks; skip bulk orikalkum on many ironman guides when mine time dominates. Pair blacksmith outfit / powerburst of masterstroke / luminite injector (w70).

methods.location: Prifddinas Trahaearn furnaces (Voice of Seren preferred)
methods.xp_rate: wiki: 160 base XP per ore (192 with Voice of Seren). With Superheat Form, ~2,000 ore/h → 400,000 XP/h with Voice of Seren active
methods.notes: Ironman AFK alternative to burial when ore banked from Seren stones / mining. Hard Tirannwn. Blacksmith outfit + VoS reduces ore to 99 (wiki: 38,642 vs 51,201 without).

methods.level_range: 77-80 primary on summary; usable higher as alternative to Anachronia
methods.location: Prifddinas Hefin district
methods.xp_rate: wiki Agility training summary: 102,857 XP/h
methods.notes: Requires Plague's End. Page flagged that 2026 mid-game rebalance reworked Agility rates — re-benchmark before optimizer truth. Serenity posts are the AFK alternative in the same district.
methods.warning: Agility training page may be out of date after 2026 mid-game rebalance XP rework.

methods.location: Dorgesh-Kaan agility course
methods.xp_rate: wiki summary: 123,750 XP/h (Hefin alternative at 102,857 in same band)
methods.notes: Starting-region high course before Anachronia island-wide. Death to the Dorgeshuun path for city access.

methods.level_range: 80/85-99+ (85 for full course; summer pie boost from 80)
methods.location: Anachronia full island agility route
methods.xp_rate: wiki summary: 210,000 XP/h; body: up to 220,000 XP/h with nimble outfit and tier-3 Anachronia base camp spa on ~6:30 laps
methods.notes: Top continuous Agility on the summary ladder. Codex pages + base camp materials. Mobile perk / Double Surge improve lap times. Powerful roar +25% XP windows.

methods.location: Prifddinas Hefin district serenity posts
methods.xp_rate: wiki: 30-58 Agility XP per second when matching Lady Hefin's pose (level-dependent); 10% of that rate on wrong pose. Implies ~108,000-208,800 XP/h if held continuously at those per-second rates — wiki does not publish a separate frozen XP/h row
methods.intensity: fully AFK after pose select (re-sync pose with Lady Hefin)
methods.notes: Plague's End required. Lower XP than courses but fully AFK. Prefer courses when attention available.

methods.level_range: 80+ Agility with 85+ Hunter; switch charming moths at 83 Agility / 88 Hunter
methods.location: Havenhythe spirit moth trees
methods.xp_rate: wiki: over 150,000 Agility XP/h with a decent rotation between trees
methods.notes: Agility-forward moth training; charming moths trade some Agility XP for better Hunter XP and charms (Wilderness). Avoid Tellervo's lantern if maximising Agility XP (wiki: lowers Agility XP when it activates).

methods.method: Line Firemaking log ladder (magic / elder / eternal magic)
methods.level_range: 75 magic; 90 elder; 100+ eternal magic (as on overview table)
methods.location: Bank-adjacent open ground (line fires); not permanent bonfires
methods.xp_rate: wiki Pay-to-play Firemaking training overview (assumes 1,200 logs/h line): magic logs 364,560 XP/h (303.8 XP/log); corrupted magic 382,800; elder 521,160 (434.3 XP/log); eternal magic 662,400 (552 XP/log)
methods.notes: Line fires ~20% faster than bonfires on magic logs per wiki discussion (2/3 the time per log). Bonfires are more AFK and spawn fire spirits. Pitch can accelerates both modes. Ironman log supply: Miscellania, Prif, Anachronia eternal magic.

methods.location: Jadinko Lair curly jade root vines + firepits
methods.xp_rate: wiki: ~250,000 Firemaking XP/h at minimum requirements with ring of fire (+ ~23,500 Woodcutting XP/h); ~305,000 Firemaking XP/h at high levels on the normal firepit route; over 670,000 Firemaking XP/h with Superheat Form (stated best method in-game on that section)
methods.intensity: active chop + burn loop; Superheat Form AFK-burn hybrid
methods.notes: Karamja. Four roots per vine; 378.5 FM XP per root. Always Adze relic is Superheat Form alternative for auto-burn.

methods.method: Permanent multi-player-equivalent bonfires (Yeti / Menaphos / Prif / Max Guild)
methods.level_range: any log tier; best with high logs
methods.location: Yeti Town (Violet is Blue), Menaphos Worker district, Prif Tower of Voices, Max Guild upper level
methods.xp_rate: wiki: permanent bonfires grant the same +4% as a 5-player bonfire; overview table bonfire column uses 950 logs/h assumption (pair with line rates above for relative speed). Prif fires add a chance to save logs
methods.notes: Prefer Prif or Max Guild for bank proximity + log save. Portable brazier is +14.4% XP and 10% save when available (main-game w84; limited for ironmen). Complements ironman bonfire ladder rates already captured in support gap files.
